tests/relayCoverage.test.ts.reason: Relay scenarios share fake admitted peers and one protocol fixture. Peer-process authentication retains its separate focused tests.

tests/e2e/fixtures/fake-codex.mjs.reason: Implements the fake Codex app-server protocol and thread lifecycle. Relay probes and background-command behavior remain in focused helper modules.

tests/e2e/fixtures/fake-claude.mjs.reason: Implements the fake Claude CLI protocol and session lifecycle used by E2E specs. Tool responses, foreground-task details and the CLI's local-command rule (fake-claude-local.mjs) remain in helper modules.

tests/store-boot.test.ts.reason: Boot scenarios share the store and native startup fixture. Window readiness is checked for both main and Quick Chat startup.

electron/capabilities/tools/computer.cjs.reason: Registers computer tool handlers over the shared permission anchor and control services. Refusal handling stays at the tool boundary.

tests/appShell.test.ts.reason: App-shell commands and render-scope cases share one mounted shell, store and native bridge. Keep the scenario matrix with that fixture.

tests/quickChatUI.test.ts.reason: Quick Chat layout and MoMo-toggle scenarios share the window's store, native bridge and mounted shell. MoMo's own pane is tested separately.

tests/browserPermissions.test.ts.reason: Browser permission modes share one fake panel and intent reader. Action-gate behavior is exercised through the same browser control fixture.

tests/composerGoalUI.test.ts.reason: Goal-composer scenarios share an isolated mounted composer and hook environment. Plugin delivery, input ownership and Stop behavior retain their focused tests.

tests/turnNavigationUI.test.ts.reason: Navigation-rail cases share mounted geometry, anchors and frame controls. Memoization is checked through the fixture's real subscriptions.

electron/capabilities/browser/script.cjs.reason: Owns browser-script execution and its guarded action surface. Locator, pointer and drag operations share cancellation and target checks. The result text carries the shared paging note (#3571): one require of it, the result line otherwise unchanged.

tests/claudeSessions.test.ts.reason: Claude session lifecycle scenarios share a fake SDK, query options and transcript environment. Process exits and encrypted account state use that same fixture.

tests/claudeCoverageSessions.test.ts.reason: Claude session control scenarios share one fake SDK and command collector. Context-detail requests are checked beside the other control operations.
